channel.description: Latest articles from Art in America (artinamericamagazine.com)

item.title: Christie’s to Offer Three Masterworks From Agnes Gund Collection This May
item.description: Long before museums made a point of broadening their collections, Gund was buying work by women and artists of color and urging institutions to do the same.

item.title: University of North Texas Cancels Victor Quiñonez Exhibition, Artist Claims Censorship over Anti-ICE Content in His Work
item.description: The University of North Texas has not released an official reason for the exhibition’s cancelation.

item.title: Adrian Searle to Step Down as the Guardian’s Chief Art Critic After Three Decades
item.description: His final article will run on April 1.

item.title: Louvre Faces €10M Loss After Decades-Long Ticket Fraud Busted
item.description: The Palace of Versailles was also implicated in the scheme, which involved the sale of counterfeit tickets.

item.title: Henrike Naumann, Sculptor Who Exhumed East Germany’s Troubled Past, Dies at 41
item.description: With Sung Tieu, she was set to represent Germany at the Venice Biennale this year.

item.title: British Museum Removed the Word ‘Palestinian’ from Some Displays Amid Pressure from Pro-Israel Group
item.description: The museum said its decision preceded a letter from UK Lawyers for Israel.

item.title: Sculptor Henrike Naumann Dies at 41, Museo de Arte Moderno de Bogota Fires Director: Morning Links for February 16, 2026
item.description: Here's what we're reading this morning, folks.

item.title: Wassily Kandinsky Painting Estimated at $21.3 M. to Headline Christie’s 20/21 Spring Evening Sale in London Alongside Henry Moore Work
item.description: It was painted when Kandinsky lived in Paris with his wife Nina. The couple moved to France from Germany in 1933 to escape the Nazi regime

item.title: David Hockney to Unveil 32-Foot-Long Window Installation for Turner Contemporary in Margate
item.description: It will transform the museum’s floor-to-ceiling window in the Sunley Gallery overlooking Margate’s beaches.

item.title: Museo Reina Sofía Calls for Investigation into Incident Involving Visitors with Israeli Flags
item.description: A widely shared by a conservative Spanish outlet claimed that the visitors were Israeli tourists.
